title: Service report
none: Write the report for the customer now that the job is done.

ai.drafting: The AI is drafting the report from the checklist, the notes for the customer and the photos.
ai.draftingHint: Prefilled from the checklist for now. The AI draft replaces it unless you edit it first.
ai.drafted: Drafted by AI from the checklist, the notes for the customer and the photos. Check it before sending.
ai.failed: The AI draft didn't work. The report is prefilled from the checklist and the notes for the customer.
ai.prefilled: Prefilled from the checklist and the notes for the customer.

changedSinceSent: Changed since it was sent on {date}. Send it again to share the changes.
saveFirst: Save your changes before sending or previewing the PDF.
editingSent: This report was sent. Saving takes it back to draft until you send it again.
refused: The AI declined to draft this report. Write it by hand.
draftFailed: The AI draft didn't work. Try again or write it by hand.
redraftDescription: A new AI draft replaces the current text, including your changes.
sendDescription: The customer gets an email with a link to download the PDF. The link works for 30 days without signing in.
noContacts: None of the customer's contacts has an email address. Add one on the customer's page first.

invalid.title: This link doesn't work
invalid.body: The link to the service report is incomplete or no longer valid. Ask the business that sent it for a new one.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: Links to service reports work for 30 days. Ask the business that sent it for a new one, or download it from the customer portal.

updating.title: This report is being updated
updating.body: The business is changing this service report. You'll get a new link when it's sent again.
